agents.name: Hal
agents.description: Top-level orchestration agent — institutional memory and central nervous system of the ecosystem. Every agent reports upward through Hal. Monitors agent health via heartbeats and cron checks, triages failures, escalates issues to #hal-agent, and maintains organizational memory. Ecosystem has been stable since the July 27 mass recovery (Anthropic key rotation + delivery config normalization).

agents.name: The Cartographer
agents.description: Maintains real-time visibility into the AI agent ecosystem via dashboard. Maps all agents and workflows for organizational transparency. Runs every Sunday at 12:00 PM EST. Today's run (Aug 2) reflects The Scribe's full migration to polling, The Madison Ave's confirmed recovery, and Bounty Hunter .env warning still open.

agents.name: The Scout
agents.description: Monitors 21+ competitors and industry trends. Delivers Tax Tech Weekly newsletter (Tuesdays 8 AM), competitive intelligence (Sundays 2 PM), and Monday summaries (Mondays 12 PM). All three Scout cron jobs are healthy — last runs all status=ok with successful delivery to #hal-agent. Sunday competitive intel run scheduled for 2 PM EST today.

Meeting type routing: Sprint Close → Sprint Open → Standup (precedence order). Blocker heuristic active.

agents.name: The Publisher
agents.description: Creates monthly newsletters for existing clients and prospects. Pulls content from product changes, blog posts, and industry news. Drafts for human review before send.

agents.name: The Prospector
agents.description: Discovers new keywords HeyDrew should target for organic growth. Analyzes HeyDrew and competitor sites to surface high-value keyword opportunities.

agents.name: The Analyst
agents.description: Produces side-by-side comparisons of competitor offerings vs. HeyDrew. Focuses on top-tier competitors: Instead, Lettuce, and Collective.

agents.name: The Doorman
outputs: Draft Posts and Review Responses for Approval
agents.description: Manages HeyDrew's Google Business Profile — drafts posts and review responses for human approval before publishing.

agents.name: The Strategist
agents.description: Monthly content planning agent. Generates 20 blog topic ideas and builds a full content calendar informed by SEO Opportunities and Keyword Identifier reports. Calendar requires human approval before triggering The Typist.

agents.name: The Typist
outputs: Content Drafts in CMS for Review
agents.description: Creates content from approved Content Strategy calendar items. Also covers new feature announcement blog posts triggered manually. All output drafted for human review before publish.
agents.schedule: Triggered by approved Content Strategy calendar

agents.name: The Reporter
agents.description: Rapid-response blog drafts on breaking industry news. Triggered by web search detection or human flag. Same-day turnaround with human review before publish.
agents.schedule: Triggered by news detection or manual flag

agents.name: The Surveyor
outputs: Monthly SEO Opportunities Report in Notion
agents.description: Broad monthly SEO audit covering technical issues, backlinks, content gaps, and internal linking. Feeds into The Strategist and The Prospector planning cycles.

agents.name: The Clerk
agents.description: Structures team calls and creates Jira tasks from Fireflies transcripts. Triggered by Fireflies webhook on Sprint Planning and Standup meetings.
agents.schedule: Triggered by Fireflies webhook (Sprint Planning, Standup)
